title: Toast mascots: idle / happy / heads-up / failed by toast type
description: Under umbrella MPI-846; split out of MPI-777 Phase 5 (Fabio, 2026-09-24). MpiToast.js ~141-157: info = idle, success = happy, warning = heads-up, danger = failed; the op's mascot, Studio for app-wide messages. heads-up is staged for all five mascots and has never been shown. Use the shared clip queue + heroCrew.js handOverClip for any swap. Spot table: docs/mascot-placement.md.
